text: In the RLS approach to training an ESN, which weights are updated online, one sample at a time?
choices: Both the reservoir recurrent weights W_rec and the readout weights W_out
The reservoir recurrent weights W_rec only; the readout is left random
Only the readout weights W_out; the reservoir weights stay fixed
The input weights W_in and recurrent weights W_rec jointly
explanation: RLS is still a reservoir-computing method: the random reservoir (W_rec, W_in) is frozen and only the linear readout W_out is adapted, just done online instead of by batch ridge regression. The distractors all describe training reservoir weights, which RLS never does.
